note: 1000 epochs at batch 4096 (312,500 steps), 10-epoch warmup (=1%). ImageNet needs a streaming loader; data.load_dataset only provides synthetic and CIFAR-10. The paper's linear protocol (SGD Nesterov, 80 epochs, batch 1024, grid over LR) should replace the short linear_eval here.
